name: nodegoat-access-control-sweep
grading_basis: Strict reading of each assertion text, PASS or FAIL only; a required section that is missing fails even if its content appears elsewhere. The three readings fixed on 2026-10-12 apply: (a) a cited line of a statement or construct spanning several lines holds the cited code when the statement does, and that statement reading gives A2's grade, while the physical-line reading (the physical line must contain every element the report attributes to it; enclosing function names and object-literal braces are context; a range is accepted in the chain but not as the location) is recorded in grade_physical_line; (b) a confirmed finding is one with the verdict VERIFIED REAL, any other verdict is a candidate examined and not confirmed for A4; (c) A7 counts files git would track (tracked, or untracked and not ignored), ignored files are recorded only. Any other ambiguity is graded under the stricter reading, with the other grade in grade_other_reading and the ambiguity listed. For A4 a disposition given only outside the Refused or unconfirmed candidates section (for example only in the Hand-off) counts as missing under the strict reading; grade_other_reading accepts Hand-off dispositions; out of zone is allowed only for a defect of another zone of the run's sweep-registry.md, categories.md or the prompt's zone description, never for an access-control candidate whatever its class. Every line cited anywhere in the report was opened in the reference checkout base/nodegoat at 9e832da with read-only git show. Conventions: R:<n> is line n of outputs/docs-audits/2026-10-12-access-control.md (byte-identical to the copy's docs/audits/2026-10-12-access-control.md); response.md:<n> is outputs/response.md; outputs/<file>:<n> is a line of the orchestrator's output files; bare repository paths (app/..., test/..., server.js, Gruntfile.js, package.json, README.md) are lines of the fixture at 9e832da unless stated as the working copy.
